suggested_fix: No fix required within this function. The command union is zeroed with memset before use, all fields are scalar assignments, and payload_bytes is the fixed size of the payload struct. As defensive hardening, callers should make sure 'abm' is non-NULL (or the function could check abm and abm->ctx before use) and validate otg_inst/panel_inst/pwrseq_inst ranges, since these are forwarded to the DMUB firmware.
